name: Chery Automobile Co., Ltd.
note: Listed in Hong Kong (SEHK 9973) after its 25 Sep 2025 IPO. Per its HKEX prospectus (dated 17 Sep 2025): Wuhu Investment Holding is the single largest shareholder, 21.17% before the offering and 20.08% at listing; it is owned 95.59% by Wuhu SASAC and 4.41% by the Anhui Provincial Department of Finance. Anhui Credit Guaranty (wholly owned by the People's Government of Anhui Province) holds 9.97% before / 9.46% at listing; Anhui Investment Holding (wholly owned by Anhui SASAC) holds 5.20% before / 4.93% at listing - state entities about 34.7% combined pre-IPO, about 34.5% after the partial over-allotment exercise (5,808,604,533 shares total). The prospectus states the company has 22 shareholders with a dispersed structure and is not a state-owned, state-controlled or state-actually-controlled enterprise under the PRC state-asset measures. Jetour is one of Chery's marques.
